taglineFallback: We read, question, and debate together.
gateIntro: Leave your email to explore the club in read-only mode, or sign up with Google to take part right away. We will email you a link to create your account.
orGoogle: — or sign up with Google above —
guestBanner: You are exploring in read-only mode. To comment, complete missions, and really join, create your account — we also email you the link.
guestBannerEmail: You are exploring in read-only mode ({{email}}). To comment, complete missions, and really join, create your account — we also email you the link.

overview.accountCta: Create an account to take part →
overview.guestBody: Explore the club in read-only mode. Create your account to complete missions and join the forum.
overview.journeyTitle: Your reading journey is about to begin
overview.membersJoined: {{count}} readers have already joined. Introduce yourself and get ready for the first mission.
overview.prepareSoon: Get ready: we will open the first mission and the group forum soon.
overview.finishedBody: Now visit the <forum>Forum</forum>, or <research>Open Investigation</research>, and if you have not yet, join the <telegram>Telegram</telegram> group. We would love to talk.
overview.forumThoughts: See what other readers are thinking in the open forum.
overview.communityMeanwhile: Join the community or the Telegram group while the next mission opens.
overview.followMission: Follow this mission's reading and come back to the forum.
overview.unlocksAt: It unlocks for the whole club on {{date}}.
overview.notOnCalendar: This mission is not available yet according to the club calendar.
overview.completePrevious: Complete the previous mission to continue.
overview.missionsPreparingBody: When staff publishes the first reading, it will appear here as your main action.
overview.collectiveStarts: The group conversation starts when more readers join and complete the first mission.
overview.forumUnavailable: The forum is not available yet
overview.forumAfterMission: The first question will open after you move ahead in Mission {{order}}. Finish your reading to enter the forum.
overview.forumWhenStaff: When staff opens the first forum question, it will appear here.
overview.openQuestionPrompt: Want to open a question? Do it from <forum>Forum</forum>.
overview.telegramBlurb: Quick conversation for the cycle: announcements, questions, and company while you read.
overview.noLiveYet: The next live meeting is not on the calendar yet.
overview.meanwhileMission: Meanwhile, keep going on your mission and take part in the forum.
overview.conversationStarting: The conversation is about to begin
overview.commentsWillAppear: When readers comment on the investigation topic, their contributions will appear here.
overview.beFirst: Be among the first to complete Mission {{order}} →

missions.title: Missions
missions.intro: The club's knowledge path is the sequence of readings and exercises for the cycle.
missions.readOnly: You can see the mission summary. To open them and track progress, create your account.
missions.opensAt: This mission will open for the whole club on {{date}}.
missions.notYet: This mission is not available yet according to the club calendar.
missions.lockedPrevious: This mission is locked until you complete the previous one.
missions.allDone: You completed every mission in this cycle. Use the Forum or Community while the next one arrives.
missions.preparingBody: When staff publishes the first reading, it will appear here as your main action.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.intro: Live gatherings linked to this club cycle.
meetings.empty: There are no meetings linked to this club yet.

community.title: Community
community.intro: Conversation for the cycle: Telegram for day to day. The topic investigation and timeline are on the Investigation tab.
community.groupBody: Announcements, quick questions, and company while you read. It is the live channel for the cycle.
community.noTelegram: There is no Telegram group linked to this club yet.
community.membersHint: Meet the people you are reading with.
community.joinToMeet: Create your account and join the club to meet the other members.
community.nobodyYet: Nobody has introduced themselves yet. Be the first with “Edit my introduction”.
community.investigationBody: The timeline and topic material are on the Investigation tab, without leaving the hub.

investigation.title: Investigation
investigation.emptyBody: Here you will see the timeline and material for the topic linked to this cycle.
investigation.loginBody: Log in or create your account to see the timeline and the topic material.
investigation.guest: You are in guest mode. Create your account to explore the club investigation.
investigation.needAccount: You need an account to see this section.

forum.title: Forum
forum.intro: Questions guided by the moderator. Post your answer to see the other members' answers.
forum.placeholder: Write the question you want to open for the club…
forum.readOnly: You can read the question. To answer and see everyone else's answers, create your account.
forum.postToUnlock: Post your answer to unlock the other members' answers.
forum.alreadyPosted: You already posted your answer. You can edit it below or reply to other members.
forum.answerPlaceholder: Share your answer. Everyone else's answers unlock when you post yours.
forum.emptyAnswers: No answers yet. Be the first.
forum.lockedEmpty: Post your answer to see the other members' answers.

intro.title: Introduce yourself to the club
intro.guestBody: Create your account to introduce yourself and take part in the community.
intro.optionalHint: Every field is optional. If you already had details on your profile, they appear here ready to confirm or edit for {{title}}.
intro.profileHelper: Optional. This is the external link on your profile.
intro.otherHelper: Optional and only for this club: website, project, newsletter…
intro.invalidUrl: Enter a valid link (for example https://your-site.com).

adminList.title: Reading clubs
adminList.intro: Create and manage book clubs. Editing happens on subpages: general, connections, meetings, and questions.
adminList.empty: There are no reading clubs yet.

general.newIntro: Start with the essentials. Then, in Connections, link the knowledge path (missions) and the Investigation topic; after that, meetings and questions.
general.heading: General details
general.title: Title
general.telegramHelper: Accepts https://t.me/..., t.me/..., or @username. Leave it empty to remove it.
general.startsHelper: Shown in the hub. Clear the field and save to remove the date.
general.coverCreateHint: The cover is sent when the club is created (max 3 MB).
general.coverEditHint: Choosing a file uploads it immediately (max 3 MB), as with knowledge paths.
general.startInvalid: The start date is not valid.
general.endInvalid: The end date is not valid.
general.imageType: The file must be an image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP).
general.coverTooLarge: The cover must not exceed 3 MB.

connections.title: Connections
connections.intro: The knowledge path feeds the hub missions. The topic feeds the Investigation tab (timeline plus counts of videos, images, podcasts, and texts). If you did not choose a path when creating the club, an empty one was generated automatically.
connections.topicHelp: Choose the topic whose timeline and library are shown inside the hub, without taking the reader out of the club. To curate timeline entries or upload content, use the topic tools.
connections.previewError: Could not load the preview for topic #{{id}}.
connections.topicList: Go to the topic list / create a new one
connections.savedWithTopic: Connections saved. The hub Investigation tab will use this topic.
connections.savedWithoutTopic: Connections saved. Investigation will stay empty until a topic is linked.

missionAdmin.title: Mission schedule
missionAdmin.intro: Each mission is open by default. Set a date only if you want to lock it until that moment. Besides the date arriving, each person must have completed the previous mission.
missionAdmin.linkPathFirst: First link a knowledge path from the Connections section.
missionAdmin.noNodes: The linked path does not have nodes yet.
missionAdmin.saved: Schedule saved. Availability updates for the whole club.

meetingAdmin.title: Club meetings
meetingAdmin.intro: Link existing events (lives / gatherings) to this club. You can create new ones in the events section.
meetingAdmin.confirmUnlink: Unlink this meeting from the club?

memberAdmin.title: Club members
memberAdmin.intro: Full list for administration. Club management (forum, meetings, content) belongs to platform staff users; you do not need to assign roles inside the club. Community only shows people who completed “Introduce yourself”.
memberAdmin.empty: There are no members in this club yet.

questionAdmin.title: Forum questions
questionAdmin.intro: Create, schedule, and close questions tied to missions or meetings. They appear in the hub (Forum) according to their status and dates. Members only see other people's answers after posting their own.
questionAdmin.confirmDelete: Delete this forum question? This cannot be undone.
